comment: Voice lineup for the /voice client-selection page. display_name is what the page shows; voice_id is the upstream TTS voice (internal only — never rendered on the page). Sample MP3s live at public/assets/voice/<slug>.mp3 and are regenerated by scripts/generate-voice-samples.py.
sample_script: Hi, thanks for calling! I'm {name}, your virtual receptionist. I can book appointments, answer questions, and take messages, any time of day or night. Now, how can I help you today?

voices.blurb: Warm and naturally conversational, with an easy Australian accent. The voice our live receptionists use today.
An intimate, friendly Australian voice that puts callers at ease straight away.
A clear, welcoming Australian voice with a polished, front-desk feel.
A warm, authentic Australian voice in her 30s. Friendly without being formal.
A younger, energetic Australian voice that keeps every caller's attention.
A relaxed, studio-quality Australian voice with a soothing, unhurried pace.
A young Australian male voice with plenty of energy. A great fit if you'd prefer a male receptionist.
